data.one_liner: A customizable circular progress widget with gradient progress value color.
data.what_it_does: Provides a circular progress indicator widget for Flutter applications. Allows displaying progress using a gradient arc along with an optional background color, custom size, stroke width, and child widget.
use_when: You need to display circular progress with a color gradient
You want an optional background color behind the unfilled portion of the indicator
You need to display a child widget inside a circular progress indicator
avoid_when: You need linear or other non-circular progress indicators
You need complex built-in indeterminate loading animations if not supported by the widget parameters
strengths: Supports gradient colors for the progress arc
Includes customizable stroke and size parameters
Allows an optional child widget placed on top of the progress
weaknesses: Limited documentation on advanced animations or indeterminate states
Single-purpose widget with minimal features beyond basic display
